ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened lower on Tuesday, with Bitcoin slipping 1.2% to $83,473 and Ethereum down 1.58% at $2,657, while most altcoins showed modest declines. The dip follows a string of regulatory headlines, including California's memecoin ban and heightened scrutiny of token buybacks, keeping risk appetite cautious.
